guide.closed: The guide has ended. You can show it again from {{settings}}, under “{{guide}}”.
guide.name: Getting started

say.accept: Read the report. When it made files, open them from “{{files}}” above to check them. If it is good, press this button ({{finish}}) and the task is finished.
say.anotherRepository: To use another repository, open this, choose “{{create}}”, and pick that repository as its working folder.
say.answer: Choosing an answer puts it in the box below. Sending it makes it your answer.
say.answered: Your answer is sent. It takes a moment to reach the AI working on it.
say.answerReady: Your answer is in. Send it with this button to make it your answer.
say.apps: You can also install alpacawork as an app on this computer, or open it from your phone. The steps are in {{settings}}, under “{{apps}}”.
say.end: That is all there is to it. Go on and ask for anything here. You can send as many requests as you like without waiting for the last one to finish.
say.question: It's your turn. Press this row to open its detail, and answer the question.
say.received: The coordinator (the AI that takes your requests) has your request. A task will appear shortly. Press here to open the conversation and read it.
say.result: A report is ready. Press this row and check it in its detail.
say.send: Now send a request. Write it here, or pick one of the examples above.
say.sendAgain: Write what you want done here and send it. It becomes a task in the list.
say.sendReady: It's in the box. Send it with this button.
say.tourCoordinator: What you send goes to the coordinator, the AI that takes your requests. It makes each one a task and hands it to an AI. Press here to open your conversation with it.
say.tourInput: This box is where you write: requests and answers to questions are both sent from here. When a label stands at its left end, the project or task it names is where the message goes.
say.unassigned: No AI has been put on this row's task yet, so it has not started. Open the row and send what you want done from the box below to start it.
say.working: Your request is listed here as a task, one row each. AI takes it from here, and when a question or a report comes for you, it moves to “{{section}}”.

send.detail: Write it in the box at the bottom and send. Or pick an example.
send.title: Send a request

turn.detail: Press the row of a task that has a question or a report for you and its detail opens. Answer the question there, or check what was made.
turn.title: Your turn

work.detail: Replies don't appear right here. Your request becomes a task in a list that takes this place, and an AI works on it.
work.title: AI works on it

pending.long: A new instruction arrived. Waiting for the owner to give a new report estimate.

timeView.axisAbsent: The time view is not saved on this device. It loads when the connection is back.
timeView.help: Scroll sideways to move through time. Zoom with ctrl (⌘) + wheel, a pinch, or two fingers. Double-click the time scale to see everything. Point at a line (tap on a phone) for details. Keys: + − 0 N; press → on a title to read its lines in turn.

decide.label: Pick a mini game idea, then have it built
decide.shows: AI offers ideas; pick one and it builds that game.
decide.words: I'd like one mini game I can play in the browser. Suggest 3 ideas and ask me which to build. Then build the one I pick in about 5 minutes. This is a trial run, so keep the effort light. Please write everything in English.

folder.label: Read this folder and suggest what to hand off next
folder.shows: Sums up what is in the working folder and asks you which piece of work to start with. Choose one and you get a report on how to do it. Changes nothing.
folder.words: Make this a task and hand it to an AI. Read what is in the working folder {{path}} and sum up in three lines what the project is. Then suggest three pieces of work I could hand off next and ask me which to start with. When I choose, put how to do that work (which files to change and how) in a report, and end it with one line on how to ask for that work to be done. Do not change any files as part of this request. This is a trial run, so keep the effort light. Please write everything in English.

models.label: Have 3 models build a snake game, then compare
models.shows: Different models build in parallel, then you're asked which to keep.
models.words: Please build a snake game that runs in the browser, 3 times in parallel, each with a different model; if there aren't enough models, vary the effort instead. When they're done, ask me which one to keep. This is a trial run, so keep the settings light and take about 5 minutes. Please write everything in English.

settings.label: Set a working rule and how many agents run at once
settings.shows: A rule joins the project policy, and at most 4 agents run at once.
settings.words: Please add this rule to this project's policy: "When you finish, report what you changed in 3 lines or fewer." Also, set this environment to run at most 4 agents at once. Please write everything in English.

folder.ask: Choose the repository or folder to use, then save.
folder.none: To use it on your own repository, choose that folder as the project's working folder.

welcome.lead: Send what you want done. AI turns it into tasks and works on them, and lists them under “{{section}}” only when your judgment is needed.
welcome.title: Welcome to alpacawork
